notes.title: DEMO UPDATE! - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/d720ab81edbb8259d5c3ba68d7f396d3f5b425d5.png[/img]

[b]New Features[/b]
- Merchant items are generated for each merchant node, and not for each sublevel
- Better visual feedback for UI buttons
- When adding a new spirit to the party the game will auto select an empty space if able
- A warning popup will now be displayed when the player is about to replace a spirit in the party with a new spirit.
- New 3D Graphics for the map nodes! 

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the game would freeze in a black screen after finishing an expedition
- Fixed a bug where registered spirits would be registered without any powers
- Bug fix for when a new turn started during combat
- Translation to pt-br for the warning pop ups in the loadout screen
- Changes in the UI 3D models to properly show illumination and particles
- Progression properly saving after forfeiting a battle during an expedition
- Fixed an issue that made it possible to mold multiple relics using the same spirit
- Fixed Upgrade Tree button that had a different size in each structure screen
- Fixed an issue where the list of skills and archetypes in the Training Grounds were being displayed repetitively
- Fixed an issue where the rapport rank up were showing the wrong character and level rewards
- Feral Warrior archetype was displaying the wrong name in pt-br
- Fixed a bug where a specific dialogue with Caipora would cause the game to freeze
- Fixed a bug where upgrades in the Upgrade Tree were showing the wrong requirements and would be impossible to be unlocked
- Fixed a bug that caused upgrades to display the wrong cost to be unlocked
